rule_text: Bet the side whose fair margin differs from the aggregator home spread by at least 3.0 points. Direction: bet the team the model likes. Stake: flat 1 unit. No injury adjustment. No threshold search.
universe_definition: Any game with both a fair line and an aggregator spread.
threshold_fixed: yes - no threshold search performed or permitted

rule_text: Bet the total whose fair total differs from the aggregator total line by at least 3.0 points. Over if fair > market, under otherwise. Flat 1 unit.
universe_definition: Any game with both a fair total and an aggregator total.
threshold_fixed: yes - no threshold search performed or permitted

rule_text: Bet the moneyline side whose model probability exceeds the de-vigged market probability by at least 0.05. Flat 1 unit.
universe_definition: Any game with both moneylines present.
threshold_fixed: yes - no threshold search performed or permitted

rule_text: Bet the home team when the aggregator spread makes it an underdog of 2.5 or more. Flat 1 unit. A pure market-state rule; no model and no probability.
universe_definition: Any game with an aggregator spread.
threshold_fixed: yes - no threshold search performed or permitted

rule_text: Bet the team with at least 3 more rest days than its opponent. If both sides qualify, skip. Flat 1 unit.
universe_definition: Any game where both rest values are published.
threshold_fixed: yes - no threshold search performed or permitted

rule_text: Bet the home team when the game is divisional and the home team is an underdog. Flat 1 unit.
universe_definition: Divisional games with an aggregator spread.
threshold_fixed: yes - no threshold search performed or permitted

rule_text: Bet the away team when the home team is favoured by 10 or more. Flat 1 unit.
universe_definition: Any game with an aggregator spread.
threshold_fixed: yes - no threshold search performed or permitted

rule_text: Parlay S1's side leg with S2's total leg when both fire on the same game. Ranked only where a directly validated joint probability exists; see gate G7.
universe_definition: Games where both S1 and S2 fire.
threshold_fixed: yes - no threshold search performed or permitted

rule_text: Combine two player-prop legs from the same game only when a measured joint probability exists and the operator's void/push rules are published.
universe_definition: Requires prop prices. None exist: see F-17.
threshold_fixed: yes - no threshold search performed or permitted
